title: Research and Develop Solutions to Estimate Arrival Time and Effective Routing
description: A Transformer-based deep learning framework for spatiotemporal travel time estimation. By leveraging Contrastive Learning and spatial Point-of-Interest contexts, it delivers highly accurate and stable ETA predictions for dense megacities.

title: Custom Robot Arm-Based Trowel Direction Determination on Wall Corners using Deep Predictive Learning
description: A deep predictive learning model determining trowel directions of a custom robot arm on wall corners to enhance autonomous construction precision.

title: Nihonghub: Interactive Web Application for Japanese Learning
description: An AI-powered interactive web application designed for Japanese language learning through video content.

title: MiniTracer: Interactive C++ Progressive Path Tracer
description: An interactive C++ progressive path tracer featuring multithreaded CPU rendering, OpenGL viewport, and Dear ImGui controls for real-time ray tracing.

title: Cloth Simulation
description: An interactive 3D cloth physics simulation implementing Verlet integration, spring-damper constraints, and real-time environment collision detection.

title: CHIP-8 Emulator
description: A high-performance CHIP-8 emulator implementation. Features a desktop version written in C++ using SDL2 for graphics and input, alongside an interactive web-based version built with React and TypeScript.

title: Ultima Tic-tac-toe agent
description: An AI Agent for Ultimate Tic Tac Toe, developed using Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and Alpha-Beta Pruning algorithms with web based demo allow pve and ai vs ai.

title: GameBoy Emulator
description: A complete GameBoy emulator written in C++ with SDL2, OpenGL, and ImGui.
